title: Proper direct image and finite-valued algebraic-closure scalar extension
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed coefficient field, and let $a:E\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a coefficient embedding [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of topologically noetherian schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $K$ be a bounded constructible complex of $E_X^c$-modules [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Use the finite-subfield-valued closure coefficient, the coefficient map $\omega_a$, and its scalar extension $T_a$ from [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization-setup]. The specified counit transpose $T_a^Y Rg_{*,E}K\longrightarrow Rg_{*,\Omega}(T_a^X K)$, namely $\operatorname{condensedPushScalar}(\omega_a,g)_K$ of [def-pur-condensed-compact-support-projection], is an isomorphism.

source.place: 6.8.14(1)--(2), 6.8.15; proper factor of the agent-formulated compact-support realization proof Step 13

proof.text: Apply the homology-level comparison theorem in every integer degree. Mathlib's DerivedCategory.isIso_iff then detects that the displayed proper coefficient comparison is an isomorphism.

theorem omegaProperCoefficientProjection_isIso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (a : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] PadicAlgCl l)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace Y] (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper g]
    (K : CondensedERealization.Constructible E X) :
    IsIso ((condensedPushScalar (omegaMap l E a) g).app K.obj)
